label: MRtrix3 fod2dec
description:
Generate FOD-based DEC maps, with optional panchromatic sharpening and/or luminance/perception correction
By default, the FOD-based DEC is weighted by the integral of the FOD. To weight by another scalar map, use the -contrast option. This option can also be used for panchromatic sharpening, e.g., by supplying a T1 (or other sensible) anatomical volume with a higher spatial resolution.

parameters.label: lum
parameters.description: Correct for luminance/perception, using default values Cr,Cg,Cb = 0.3,0.5,0.2 and gamma = 2.2 (*not* correcting is the theoretical equivalent of Cr,Cg,Cb = 1,1,1 and gamma = 2).

parameters.label: lum_coefs
parameters.description:
The coefficients Cr,Cg,Cb to correct for luminance/perception. 
Note: this implicitly switches on luminance/perception correction, using a default gamma = 2.2 unless specified otherwise.
parameters.usage: 使用原始命令参数；未指定的可选参数不传给软件。
parameters.software_default: 参见本机安装版本原始帮助。

parameters.label: lum_gamma
parameters.description:
The gamma value to correct for luminance/perception. 
Note: this implicitly switches on luminance/perception correction, using a default Cr,Cg,Cb = 0.3,0.5,0.2 unless specified otherwise.
parameters.usage: 使用原始命令参数；未指定的可选参数不传给软件。
parameters.software_default: 参见本机安装版本原始帮助。

parameters.label: threshold
parameters.description: FOD amplitudes below the threshold value are considered zero.
parameters.usage: 使用原始命令参数；未指定的可选参数不传给软件。
parameters.software_default: 参见本机安装版本原始帮助。

parameters.label: no_weight
parameters.description: Do not weight the DEC map; just output the unweighted colours. Reslicing and renormalising of colours will still happen when providing the -contrast option as a template.

parameters.label: quiet
parameters.description: do not display information messages or progress status; alternatively, this can be achieved by setting the MRTRIX_QUIET environment variable to a non-empty string.

parameters.label: nthreads
parameters.description: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).
parameters.usage: 使用原始命令参数；未指定的可选参数不传给软件。
parameters.software_default: 参见本机安装版本原始帮助。

input_slots.label: input
input_slots.description: The input FOD image (spherical harmonic coefficients).

input_slots.label: mask
input_slots.description: Only perform DEC computation within the specified mask image.

input_slots.label: contrast
input_slots.description:
Weight the computed DEC map by the provided image contrast. If the contrast has a different image grid, the DEC map is first resliced and renormalised. To achieve panchromatic sharpening, provide an image with a higher spatial resolution than the input FOD image; e.g., a T1 anatomical volume. Only the DEC is subject to the mask, so as to allow for partial colouring of the contrast image. 
Default when this option is *not* provided: integral of input FOD, subject to the same mask/threshold as used for DEC computation.

output_slots.label: output
output_slots.description: The output DEC image (weighted RGB triplets). The output meaning depends on the input and selected operation. This generic image port does not certify anatomical labels, diffusion orientation, tissue fractions or spatial alignment.
